name: Qwen Image Edit
description: Edits the annotated frame following the drawing and the instruction. Runs on your GPU; nothing leaves this machine.

optionalModels.note: Only used when 'Enable 4steps LoRA' is on. About 5x faster; worth installing later. The filename must match the graph exactly: the validator downgrades a missing OPTIONAL model to a warning by comparing this string, so a near-miss here would block the whole template on a file the workflow never loads.

notes: Derived from the user's own working ComfyUI workflow, with five nodes retitled.
Bound by node title, never by node id: ids change on every re-export from ComfyUI, titles do not.

Predates the role-based API: no cleanFrame/annotatedFrame slots, so it cannot serve edit_pose or edit_keyframe through intent resolution. Declared with no intents on purpose -- it stays reachable by an explicit templateId, and nothing resolves to it by accident.
